chose: A screen of the app is drawn only from what home hands beside the essay, as it hands takes, each kind in its own folder: <key>.snips/ (snips.json, some-ui.snips-given/1, and the pictures) and <key>.clips/ (each frame at <clip>/<side>/<file>). record:cards takes --snips and --clips, checks each snip picture's hash and that each frame is a PNG, and refuses before anything is drawn a screen it wasn't handed or a part its snip doesn't name. A cut list still naming one is refused by resolve(), which every render passes through, so no frame is ever blank. A cards essay may show one in place of a card, and its card burn-ins still draw over it as the author wrote them. The whole screen is drawn as the renderer draws any still, fitted into the frame. The device frame or full-bleed 9:16 for phone shots stays the owner's choice (SNIPS4).
